description:
FILED s525 (Fable, 2026-10-24) by the round-4 board attribution.  Role-Tiny namespace-clean.t produced NO rows on -38/-39 and 4 failing rows from -40 (s522b's #3511 made the stash-delete slice reach p-delete's write-through, so the file RUNS; a worse failure became counted rows -- the s408 rule).  Rows 2/3 = #3632 (the nested BEGIN runs in place).  Rows 1/4 are THIS: the poor man's namespace::clean deletes the imports in a BEGIN; the later main-line `ok !defined &Local::Class::with` is compiled AFTER that delete, so perl looks the glob up fresh and finds nothing; PCL answers defined.

PROBE (scratchpad p525p/delsym.pl), perl 5.40.3 vs PCL main 95c4fe37:
  package Other; sub imp { 42 }  package L; *imp = \&Other::imp; sub own { 1 }
  package main; no strict "refs"; delete $L::{imp};
  symbolic defined &{"L::imp"}: perl gone / PCL gone
  exists &{"L::imp"}:          perl gone / PCL gone
  eval "defined &L::imp":      perl gone / PCL STILL     <- a defined-& compiled after the delete reads the CL function cell, not the stash
  L->can("imp"):               perl no / PCL no
(A `defined &L::imp` compiled BEFORE the delete is "STILL defined" in perl too -- the GV was captured at compile time; PCL matches that case: p525p/delcode.pl.)  Fix: the literal-name `defined &NAME` / `exists &NAME` forms must read the same place p-delete clears (the stash entry), or p-delete must also clear the sub's definedness -- whichever the box model says is the ONE truth (ir-spec section 7.3, the stash view).  Layer: cl/pcl-runtime.lisp.

Board rows: Role-Tiny-2.002004-0 namespace-clean.t #1 and #4 blessed with this cause (s525).  Acceptance: the eval-string line prints gone; namespace-clean.t rows 1 and 4 pass (2 and 3 stay #3632).

=== QUEUED (s530, Fable, 2026-10-31) ===
One of the 41 REAL whole-file CPAN board failures (the USER-asked review; 138 FAIL files = 69 perl-skips + 4 fixed + 2 perl-fails + 22 ruled not-supported + 41 real).  Queued as s531a member 3 with #3831 -- `briefs-and-rules-for-claude-subagents/s530/s531a-prompt.md` / `s531b-prompt.md`.


=== DONE (s531a, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-01) ===
With #3831's mark: a LITERAL `defined &NAME` / `exists &NAME` binds its glob when its top-level form LOADS -- p-sub-defined / p-sub-exists became macros expanding to (%p-sub-defined-1 PKG NAME (load-time-value (%p-sub-deleted-at-load PKG NAME))): a site loaded before the delete keeps answering by the :defined status (perl's pinned glob, p525p/delcode.pl), a site loaded after it reads the mark (the namespace::clean shape).  Emission text unchanged (the macros expand runtime-side); probed identical on a text load (runpcl), the compiled script cache (first and second run) and a module fasl (scratch/s531a/pr/nsc.pl).  The task's eval-string line prints gone.  Board: Role-Tiny namespace-clean.t rows 1 + 4 out (2/2; rows 2 + 3 stay #3632).  Guard: Pl/t/stash-delete-code-01.t row 2.  Branch head: b969a960.
